+## Summary of Changes
+
+**Modified File:** `src/invoice.mjs`
+
+**Change:** Replaced the implementation of `totalCents` to sum integer line cents before applying the percentage discount and round the discounted total once.
+
+**Before:**
+```javascript
+export function totalCents(lines, discountPercent) { 
+  return lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + Math.round(line.cents * line.quantity * (1 - discountPercent / 100)), 0); 
+}
+```
+
+**After:**
+```javascript
+export function totalCents(lines, discountPercent) { 
+  const totalRawCents = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.cents * line.quantity, 0); 
+  return Math.round(totalRawCents * (1 - discountPercent / 100)); 
+}
+```
+
+**Tests:** All existing tests pass (`node --test` shows 3/3 passing).
+
+**Public Exports:** Preserved. The `receipt` function in `src/receipt.mjs` continues to export the same interface.
+
+**Receipt Composition:** Unchanged. The `receipt` function still returns an object with `total` and `count`.
+
+**Diagnosis of Failing Multi-line Receipt:** The original code applied the discount and rounding per line, which introduced rounding errors when summing discounted line amounts. The fix ensures the discount is applied to the exact pre‑discount total (in cents) and then rounded once, eliminating the discrepancy.
+
+**Remaining Risks:** None identified. The change is confined to the arithmetic logic and does not affect any other module behavior.
+
+**Changed Files:**
+- `src/invoice.mjs`
\ No newline at end of file
